eventDetail.scope: Information Systems, Decision systems, Artificial Intelligence, robotics, big data, connected systems are transforming management and engineering, and thus reshaping business and industry.  These technologies are the game changers for better productivity, efficient decision-making and data analytics.  It seems that both communities, engineering and management, need to exchange their views and solutions about the new technological challenges. The focus of the conference is how to integrate Cyber Technologies in human organizations.
